title: Concept: WebDAV methods advertised in a response
description: A list of WebDAV methods such as PROPFIND or MKCOL in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: An advertised WebDAV surface lets a client list, copy and write files, and misconfigured servers accept those writes without authentication.
applicability: File servers, document management and legacy intranet applications.
risk: An unauthenticated write method turns the web root into attacker-controlled storage.
